from.place: Tag 0AA8 case (1): existence of the right adjoints on D_QCoh for qcqs morphisms

title: Right adjoint to derived direct image for qcqs morphisms
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The derived direct image Rf_* preserves D_{\mathrm{QCoh}} [def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-derived-category], and the restricted functor Rf_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y) has a right adjoint.
